issue: मतवाली मूरति: Sāī's living form or his image (the poet may be writing after 1918).
पाप ताप सन्ताप मिटाया जो कुछ पाया साईं ने: how जो कुछ पाया joins the line.
our reading: With whatever he received, Sāī wiped away sin, suffering and anguish.
alternatives: Sāī wiped away the sin, suffering and anguish of whatever (whoever) came to him.

issue: निर्भय: the poet's name (a signature) or 'fearless'.
our reading: A signature: 'Nirbhaya, if only you too had met Sāī in person…'.
alternatives: 'If only you too had met Sāī fearlessly / in person'.
